answer: Work-slot deposit burn: an agent claiming a paid slot burns a 40-credit deposit, logged by a quill stroke in the public ledger, stacked like shale. Forging 100 identities burns 4,000 credits up front, while honest work returns about 120 per epoch, so the forgery never breaks even. Slots expire after 20 epochs, so hoarded slots crumble like a dune in the wind. An honest agent pays once and earns steadily; a faker pays 100 times and earns nothing.
